Showcase Slide 1 of 15 “On Box's evaluation of real enterprise knowledge work, Gemini 3.7 Flash was both more accurate and significantly faster than the prior model, with its largest gains on the most challenging analytical tasks. This is the kind of progress that expands what AI can take on for organizations.” Yashodha Bhavnani, VP of AI Products, Box “The Gemini 3.7 Flash agent was 35% cheaper than 3.6 Flash, with a +8% observed prompt-cache hit rate and fewer tool errors.” Gregor Zunic, Co-founder & CTO, Browser Use “We’re excited by how well the new Gemini Flash model understands motion across time. For Cartwheel, that means more than recognizing what’s in a frame—it means following an action and reasoning about whether the motion is actually useful. We saw promising results on both fronts.” Andrew Carr, CoFounder and Chief Scientist, Cartwheel “Until now, getting high-quality answers from complex enterprise data has been expensive at scale. Models like Gemini 3.7 Flash are changing that by delivering better intelligence at dramatically lower cost. With Gemini 3.7 Flash on Databricks AI Gateway, enterprises can ask big questions of their data, like predicting next week’s revenue, identifying key customers, or deciding where to invest next.” Ivan Zhou, AI Research Manager, Databricks “Gemini 3.7 Flash’s multimodal capabilities shine on Emergent, accurately translating design inspiration and brand guidelines into full-stack web and mobile applications. It has never been easier for anyone, from small business owners to entrepreneurs, to bring their ideas to life.” Madhav Jha, Co-Founder and CTO, Emergent “Gemini 3.7 Flash is a significant improvement over prior Flash models on legal work. Based on our early testing, the model lifts all-pass by 2.6 pts compared to Gemini 3.6 Flash on Legal Agent Bench, with broad gains in quality across practice areas.” Niko Grupen, Head of Applied Research, Harvey “The new Gemini Flash model delivered Opus-level grounding performance, nearly matching information recall with materially higher precision. Combined with faster and more token-efficient outcomes, it makes for a very intriguing model.” Adithya Ramanathan, Head of Agent Development & Research, Hebbia “On a subset of Harbor-Index run inside our DeepAgents harness, the model scored in the same band as the strongest models we tested, and it was the only model in our comparison to make progress on some tasks that defeated all the others. For a model in this tier, that is an excellent result on multi-step agentic work.” Nick Hollon, Software Engineer, LangChain “Gemini ​3.7 Flash achieves on-par performance with mid-sized models such as GPT-5.6-Terra on our benchmarks, but at around half the cost, making it a strong contender in that category.” Kyrill Hux, Co-Founder, Nunu.ai “Gemini 3.7 Flash very efficiently implemented and audited its work on tasks porting Figma designs into code, with precise visual parity that other frontier models struggle with. I'm genuinely in a design 'psychosis' moment with this model. It just works.” Luke Parker, Senior Software Engineer, OpenCode “Google keeps making the strongest case that multimodal agents are ready for production — with Gemini 3.7 Flash, sharing video with a model becomes both natural and dramatically more efficient. It's supported in Pydantic AI from day one, alongside Gemini Live, which powers our new realtime agents.” Douwe Maan, Lead Developer, Pydantic AI “On a complex neurodegenerative disorder study experimental plan, I found Gemini 3.7 Flash's answer original and remarkably consistent with the latest experimental data. Compared to other models, this is the most compelling and accurate answer I have received coming very very close to what I see in the lab." Piere Rodriguez Aliaga Ph.D., Basic Life Research Scientist, Stanford Department of Biology “Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite delivers the intelligence, speed, and cost efficiency needed for Ashler’s agentic retrieval and tool-use tasks. It excels at analyzing fragmented infrastructure records while maintaining context across hundreds of deliverables, supporting our users as they build the next generation of power grids, transportation networks, and data centers.” Connor Goggins, Co-founder & CTO, Ashler “Google Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite is a huge jump from Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, punching way above its weight class. Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite has proven incredibly fast and reliable. Ultimately, the model unlocks direct accessibility, giving users a highly responsive option they can choose on demand for smooth, uninterrupted execution.” Ashwin Kannan, Principal AI Engineer, Palo Alto Networks “Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite landed on the Pareto frontier in our receipt extraction benchmark, offering one of the best tradeoffs we’ve tested between accuracy, latency, and cost. That combination is critical at Ramp, where we need to process receipts quickly and reliably at scale.” Veeral Patel, Head of Applied AI, Ramp Slide 1 of 6 Your browser does not support the video tag. ## Model Description (Gemini 3 Deep Think)
Gemini 3 Deep Think is an inference-time compute-scaling reasoning mode integrated within Google DeepMind's Gemini 3 model family. It generates internal step-by-step reasoning chains, evaluates parallel hypothesis paths, and performs self-verification to solve complex multi-step problems in mathematics, physics, materials science, and software engineering.
